title: Plugin Catalog
description: v1/index.json, the merged document nginx-ui hosts fetch. Mirrors internal/plugin.CatalogDocument in nginx-ui. Built by scripts/build-catalog.mjs from plugins/*.json and the GitHub Releases of each plugin, never committed.

schema_version.description: Matches internal/plugin.CatalogSchemaVersion. A host that does not recognize this value refuses the whole document.

name.description: Name of the catalog a host shows for this source.

icon.description: Square image a host shows for this source.
